description: How each retrofit changes the home's recorded state for the after-retrofit Green Home Score. Values are 'at least' targets: a state that is already better is never downgraded. The EPC SAP score is NOT re-assessed, so energy_efficiency is unchanged. Energy intensity is recomputed from the simulated after-energy.

loft_insulation.basis: assumption: post-installation loft (270 mm) is rated Good in RdSAP

cavity_wall.basis: assumption: filled cavity is rated Good in RdSAP

solid_wall.basis: assumption: insulated solid wall is rated Good in RdSAP

heat_pump.basis: heating type changes; EPC heating rating not re-assessed, heat-pump floor applies

solar_pv.basis: new PV of unknown size scores 'some PV' (60), not 'large PV'
